research_metadata.coverage_notes: Comprehensive search conducted for higher education institutions in Sindhupalchok district, Bagmati Province. While many higher secondary schools offer +2 programs, verified standalone higher education campuses/colleges granting Bachelor's degrees or affiliated with universities are limited. Additional community campuses operate under Tribhuvan University affiliation.

identity.name: Jalpa Devi Multiple Campus
identity.short_description: A community-based multiple campus providing higher education in Sindhupalchok district.
identity.description: Jalpa Devi Multiple Campus is a community-owned higher education institution located in Chautara Sangachokgad Municipality of Sindhupalchok district. Affiliated with Tribhuvan University, it offers undergraduate programs primarily focused on education and humanities streams to serve local students.

academics.teaching_methodology: Lectures, practical works, and assignments as per university guidelines.

programs.name: Bachelor of Education (B.Ed)
programs.eligibility: +2 or equivalent in any discipline from a recognized board.

admission.guidance: Admissions open annually following the academic calendar of Tribhuvan University.
requirements: Passed +2 or equivalent examination with minimum required GPA/marks.
application_process: Obtain application form from campus administration
admission.entrance_details: Entrance exams administered as required by TU faculty guidelines.

institutional_profile.mission: To provide accessible, quality higher education to the youth of Sindhupalchok district.
institutional_profile.vision: To develop into a leading community center for higher learning and academic excellence.
why_choose_this_college: Affordable higher education locally available in Chautara

student_life.campus_experience: A supportive community environment fostering academic and personal growth.

research_gaps: Limited presence of active independent college websites in Sindhupalchok district; most higher education operates via small community campuses or school-integrated +2 programs.
Lack of detailed digitized records for CTEVT technical diploma institutes within the district.
